answer: Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
